recoveredGoModules.why: Pickle's go.mod pins this pseudo-version, but the commit is no longer on any branch, so proxy.golang.org and `go` itself answer "unknown revision". GitHub still serves the commit by its full SHA. The build zips it into a local module proxy, and Go checks the zip against the h1: hash Pickle committed in go.sum, so the build fails rather than use different code.

artifacts.note: With -trimpath (passed through GOFLAGS; upstream's build script is unchanged) pickle.wasm doesn't depend on the build directory: two builds in different directories on 2026-11-18 (macOS arm64, go1.25.0) were byte-identical. The build script fails if it differs.
